GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.7 (21 Sept 45) CI
(SCAPIN-40)
APO 500
21 September 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Apprehension of Certain Individuals.
It is director that you apprehend and deliver to the custody of commanding General, Eighth Army, General Nobuyuki Abe and General Kenji Doihara.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/Harold Fair,
/t/HAROLD FAIR,
Lt Colonel, A. G. D.
Asst. Adjutant General.
